heading: Other Covid indicators

sections.heading: Massachusetts:
lines: Reported cases: 1,328, up from 1,070 (week ending Nov. 21)
ER visits with Covid: 0.66%, up from 0.62% (CDC trend: increasing) (week ending Nov. 21)
New hospital admissions: 76, down from 82 (week ending Nov. 14)
sections.source_note: Sources: reported cases from the [Mass. Department of Public Health](https://www.mass.gov/info-details/covid-19-reporting); ER visits from the [CDC](https://data.cdc.gov/Public-Health-Surveillance/NSSP-Emergency-Department-Visit-Trajectories-by-St/rdmq-nq56); hospital admissions from the [CDC](https://data.cdc.gov/Public-Health-Surveillance/Weekly-Hospital-Respiratory-Data-HRD-Metrics-by-Ju/ua7e-t2fy).

sections.heading: Closer to home, week ending Nov. 21:
lines: Middlesex County: 6.1% of tests positive, down from 7.1%

caveat: Reported cases undercount actual numbers, since home tests aren't reported to the state.
